name: Linh Ung Pagoda, Son Tra
summary: The 67-meter Quan The Am faces the sea from the Son Tra peninsula. Ride out, then walk the terrace at Linh Ung. Allow half a day, because the ride is the visit.
timeNeeded: Half a day with the ride
fee: No fee is published. Check on arrival.
getThere: Bai But, on the Son Tra peninsula, about 10 km northeast of the center. Go by car or Grab.
